name: ernestdefoe/hearth
description: Hearth — a warm, cozy theme for small hobby communities on Flarum 2. Paper tones, pill navigation, rounded cards, a good-afternoon welcome card, chat-bubble posts, a tag shelf of jars, drawn kettle, jar and lamp illustrations, and an amber-lit Evening mode.

suggest.flarum/tags: Tags become the coloured pantry in the sidebar and the shelf of jars on the Tags page.
suggest.ernestdefoe/homecoming: Hearth uses Homecoming's welcome strip instead of its own welcome card when it is enabled.
suggest.ernestdefoe/festoon: Hearth's seasonal touches stand down while Festoon dresses the forum.
suggest.fof/forum-widgets-core: Place Hearth's House rules card anywhere FoF Forum Widgets can.
suggest.ernestdefoe/wardrobe: Run Hearth next to other themes and let members choose.

scripts-descriptions.test:setup: Sets up a database for use with integration tests. Execute this only once.
